question: In a certain code language, ‘MARCH’ is written as ‘LBQDG’ and ‘TAXAS’ is written as ‘SBWBR’. How will ‘PIECE’ be written in the given language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

‘MARCH’ is written as ‘LBQDG’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44a9b0dd1379a163b37be335f8746cdf1017f727edb07ab64f3633e6bbe0c590.png] 

And,

‘TAXAS’ is written as ‘SBWBR’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af67fc19acb488b85f0596aa6a228085790dd6adbea7bfac18638b541abe0782.png] 

Similarly,

‘PIECE’ will be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce2ba55ccde88d9b532486766595940afa80d12792402c2a264a3175020655c0.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
